name: Yuehua Huiying zhi Ke
source: This is the profound bond born from the gap between the two sides of Yin and Yang. The world only speaks of Kaifeng's prosperity and peacefulness, but it is difficult to see the hidden, dark underside. The beautified facade and the cruel truth. The thoughts of the living and the blessings of the dead. So, will you stop here, or investigate everything?
translation: This is the profound bond born from the gap between the two sides of Yin and Yang. The world only speaks of Kaifeng's prosperity and peacefulness, but it is difficult to see the hidden, dark underside. The beautified facade and the cruel truth. The thoughts of the living and the blessings of the dead. So, will you stop here, or investigate everything?
